characteristics.$text:
- Ronin Imperial models count as Faction models in all respects.
- Friendly Bǎi Qiān models gain Fear (5) and do not suffer Melee penalties for having Run.
- On Turn 1, Friendly Fangshi models' first Focus Action is a Simple Action rather than Complex.
- Darkness: During the first turn, Non-Sixth Sense, Non-Bakemono, Non-Soulless models may only draw LoS up to 4".

Permitted [Imperial, Ronin Imperial]

If your Warband includes any Fangshi models it must include at least one Warden model.
If your Warband includes three or more Fangshi models it must include at least two Warden models.
